name: Spiked Cocktail
text: When you play this card to a trick of another suit, choose a card in that trick to gain 4 rank or lose 4 rank.

signature.trigger: you play this card off suit

archetypes: Contract Attacker, Nil Champion, Blind Bidder, Nil Guard; splash Discard Dominance
decision: Which trick to spend it on and which way to push: lower an opponent's winner so your partner takes a trick they counted on, or raise an opposing nil bidder's card over the top to break the nil.
opponent: Visible when it resolves, once a round, and only on cards already played; opponents answer by keeping an extra winner or ducking deeper than 4 ranks.
aiNote: If an opponent is on nil and their card is within 4 ranks of winning, raise it; if your partner's card is within 4 ranks of the winning opponent's card, raise it; otherwise lower the opponent's winning card. Play it as your first off-suit card that changes a trick.
rationale: Four ranks usually flips one trick (a king falls to a nine, a nine rises to a king), which is about one trick's swing a round, fair for an uncommon enabler. Any card already in the trick qualifies, so it lifts your partner's card over the winner, lowers an opponent's winner, or pushes an opponent's nil card into a win. It edits played cards, so it never acts after bidding (Sinking Anchor). Counting trumps as well as discards keeps it live when the engraved card is a spade.
deviation: Timing moved from "when you discard this card" to "when you play this card to a trick of another suit", because a spade-engraved copy could never be discarded and would be dead a quarter of the time. Revision 1: any card in the trick qualifies, not only an opponent's.
